subject: SupplyChain Assurance: VM playbook, SBOM pipeline, and patch SLA
messages:
From: Daniel Shore <dan.shore@apexfin.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@apexfin.com>, security@apexfin.com
Date: 2026-11-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: VM evidence & SBOM generation details for compliance pack

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As part of our third-party assurance checklist we need a concise package covering:
- How Redwood generates and maintains SBOMs for deployed models and runtime components (format, cadence, toolchain).
- SAST/DAST cadence and triage flow (who owns tickets, SLA expectations).
- Pen test summary (most recent findings and remediation status).
- Patch SLAs by severity and how you validate patch rollout across Dedicated and Private deployments.

Can you provide a single artifact we can attach to the vendor assessment? A short playbook + supporting artifacts would be ideal. Let me know if you need an NDA or an APL before we exchange artifacts.

Regards,
Daniel
Senior InfoSec Manager
Apex Financial

---
Note: Apex is a regulated financial services firm; we need evidence suitable for our internal audit team.

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Shore <dan.shore@apexfin.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence & SBOM generation details for compliance pack

Hi Daniel —

Appreciate the clear list. We can deliver a focused package today that maps to your auditor checklist. High-level summary below and I attached an index to the full playbook. Detailed artifacts (SBOM, pen-test summary, patch SLA matrix) are attached.

Quick answers up-front:
- SBOMs: generated from our build pipeline (CycloneDX v1.4) for all server-side components and third-party packages; regenerated on every release and on-demand for security reviews. SBOM files are stored immutable in our secure artifact store with SHA256 provenance.
- SAST/DAST: SAST runs on every PR in CI (Semgrep + commercial SCA rules); DAST runs weekly against staging mirrors and before major releases. Findings are triaged by assigned owners in our Vulnerability Operations board; critical findings have a 7-day mitigation SLA, high 30 days, medium 90 days.
- Pen test: last external test Q3 2026 (see attached summary). All critical findings were remediated and validated in subsequent retests; remaining medium items are on a tracked remediation sprint and will be closed in our December release.
- Patch SLA & rollout: patch SLAs are documented in the attached matrix. We push security fixes to Hosted immediately, Dedicated within maintenance windows with a 7-day emergency patch SLA, Private deployments follow customer-controlled rollout but we provide signed patches and validation playbooks; we also offer a limited managed rollout service on request.

Next steps:
1) I’ll share the playbook + artifacts (attached).
2) If Apex needs an attestation, Marissa can prepare a signed letter and DocuSign envelope.
3) If you prefer, we can run a 45-minute technical deep-dive with your auditors and our SRE/Security leads (we recommend a short demo of SBOM generation + CI to show provenance).

Attaching: index for the package and the SBOM/pen-test/patch matrix.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vm-playbook-redwood-appendix.docx, sbom-cyclonedx-2026-10.xml, pen-test-summary-q3-2026.pdf, patch-sla-matrix.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Shore <dan.shore@apexfin.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence & SBOM generation details for compliance pack

Daniel —

Adding more specifics so your audit team can map to controls:

SBOM provenance & pipeline:
- We use CycloneDX format, include package name, version, PURL where available, license, and checksum.
- SBOMs generated at two points: (a) build-time for server and runtime artifacts, (b) container image scan for runtime images before deployment.
- Storage & immutability: SBOM artifacts are signed with our CI signing key and pushed to the artifact store (WORM) with retention metadata.
- Drift detection: nightly job compares deployed image SBOMs vs canonical build SBOM and raises alerts for untracked changes.

SAST/DAST & triage:
- SAST stack: Semgrep for patterns, customized rules for model-surface code, and SCA (OSS inventory) for dependency issues.
- DAST: authenticated crawler + fuzz targets against staging. Weekly scans; pre-release deep scans.
- Triage workflow: findings create tickets in JIRA security project (SEC- pipeline). Owner assignment automated via code-owner + severity mapping.
- Verification: PR with fix must include test or scan proving the vulnerability is resolved; QA verifies in staging.

Patch SLA matrix (summary):
- Critical: 7 calendar days to mitigation + hotpatching; verified in staging and pushed to Hosted within 24–48 hours after verification.
- High: 30 calendar days to mitigation.
- Medium: 90 calendar days.
- Low: next scheduled maintenance window (6 months).

Pen test summary (high level):
- External tester: RedCrest Security (engagement Q3 2026).
- Findings: 0 critical, 2 high (both fixed), 6 medium (3 fixed, 3 in remediation sprints). Evidence: remediation tickets and retest reports included in the attached PDF.

Evidence links included in the package: drive folder with SBOMs, JIRA query for active security tickets, and the pen-test retest report.

If you want, I can produce a short mapping doc that ties each item to SOC 2/ISO control IDs.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sbom-cyclonedx-2026-10.xml, pen-test-summary-q3-2026.pdf

From: Daniel Shore <dan.shore@apexfin.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence & SBOM generation details for compliance pack

Vivek / Neha —

This is great, thanks. A few quick clarifications from our audit team after they reviewed the attachments:
1) For private (customer-managed) deployments, can you confirm whether SBOM generation is automated on the customer side or delivered as an artifact from Redwood?
2) Can you share the CI key signing certificate (or thumbprint) used to sign SBOMs so our integrity checks can be validated?
3) For the patch SLA: if a dedicated customer opts out of automatic patching, what documentation do you provide to demonstrate timely communication of security advisories?

If you can answer these in writing and include the certificate thumbprint, we can close the request from our side. Otherwise we may ask for a short call.

Regards,
Daniel

---
Apex audit prefers brief written confirmations they can file with evidence rather than extra calls where possible.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Shore <dan.shore@apexfin.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: VM evidence & SBOM generation details for compliance pack

Hi Daniel —

Answers below, and I attached a short signed attestation plus a DocuSign link for formal signature.

1) Private deployments: SBOMs are delivered as artifacts from Redwood for customers who manage their own environments. We offer automation guidance and a small ops toolkit to run the same SBOM generation steps in customer infra; if the customer elects, we can also enable a managed SBOM-generation hook as part of our Private offering.

2) CI signing: SBOMs are signed with our CI code-signing certificate. Thumbprint (SHA256): A1B2C3D4E5F67890123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF0123456789ABCDEF01. We will provide a copy of the signing cert in the secure Drive folder (read-only).

3) Opt-out documentation: For Dedicated/Private customers who opt out of automatic patching, Redwood provides a Security Advisory pack with: timeline of discovered issue, recommended mitigations, impact assessment, and recommended backout plan. We also deliver signed patches and an example change approval form; communications are logged via the customer ticketing channel and a copy is stored in the customer’s compliance folder.

DocuSign: https://docusign.net/envelope/ENV-APX-9987 (attestation: Redwood confirms scope of artifacts and remediation statements above)

Marissa Cole
Head of Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: signed-attestation-apex.pdf
